Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

HonestDiDFEct 1.0.0

First release as a separate package, forked from HonestDiD 0.2.8 by Ashesh Rambachan and Jonathan Roth.

  • createSensitivityResults() and createSensitivityResults_relativeMagnitudes() take the placebo output of fect as it comes, with numPrePeriods counting s = 0. They difference the coefficients from s = 0 and then run the code of HonestDiD, so every restriction and method of these two functions works on fect output.
  • The default grids are centered on the estimate, so a bound no longer stops at the edge of a grid centered on zero. grid.lb and grid.ub are in units of the target.
  • The two functions stop with a message unless the coefficients are consecutive placebo periods ending at s = 0, followed by post-treatment periods 1, 2, and so on. A run with loo = TRUE stops here.
  • constructOriginalCS() works as in HonestDiD, on the coefficients as given.
  • computeConditionalCS_*(), findOptimalFLCI(), DeltaSD_lowerBound_Mpre() and DeltaSD_upperBound_Mpre() are now internal, because they expect coefficients with a reference period left out.
  • Two fixes to the code of HonestDiD are kept. The conditional test no longer stops with an error when a variance is zero, and the grid for the test inversion accepts ends that are 1 x 1 matrices.

Developed by Ashesh Rambachan, Jonathan Roth, Ziyi Liu.
